social-viewer.name: Social Viewer
social-viewer.description: Safe, read-only inspection of social channels, draft posts, schedules, published posts, portal details, brand structure, user permissions, mentions, Pinterest boards, and media assets. No creation, update, publish, or delete actions.

social-creator.name: Social Creator & Drafter
social-creator.description: Daily content creation without direct public publishing or schedule manipulation: draft posts, media library uploads (local Base64 or remote URL), post validation, Pinterest board creation, and internal activity comments. Excludes immediate publishing and live schedule deletion.

social-publisher.name: Social Publisher & Scheduler
social-publisher.description: Full social publishing operations: schedule posts, update timing, publish immediately across networks, and manage post approvals. Soft draft deletion is permitted. Direct live schedule deletion is reserved for admin.

social-admin.name: Social Administrator
social-admin.description: Complete operational administration for Zoho Social: all 31 MCP tools, including schedule deletion and post lifecycles across brands and channels.

post-drafting.name: Post Drafting & Validation
post-drafting.description: Discover portals, brands, and channels, validate content against network constraints, and save draft posts.

publishing-and-scheduling.name: Publishing & Scheduling
publishing-and-scheduling.description: Validate and either immediately publish or schedule social posts across connected channels.

media-asset-management.name: Media Asset Management
media-asset-management.description: Upload images to the brand media library from local files (Base64) or URLs, and list existing assets.

social-monitoring.name: Social Monitoring & Performance
social-monitoring.description: Read published post performance, post activity logs, user roles, and post status counts.
